chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Umar ibn Abdul Aziz, from a man, from Jameel ibn Darraj and others, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Hasten to teach your children the Hadith before the Murji'ah spoil it to them.

key_terms.الْمُرْجِئَةُ: The Murji'ah (a theological sect known for delaying judgment on faith and deeds)

ai.seo_question: How should parents ensure their children receive correct religious teachings according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) urges parents to proactively instill authentic religious narratives in their children before the *Murji'ah* sect, known for delaying judgment and holding distinct theological views, can shape their understanding. This instruction highlights the Shia emphasis on early religious socialization as a safeguard against doctrinal deviation, ensuring the child's foundation is rooted in Ahl al-Bayt teachings rather than competing Sunni or theological schools.
